items.desc_zh: 莎拉·哈利法因其处理犯罪问题的电视节目《碟中谍》而闻名。

items.title_en: Prince William to attend King Harald's funeral in Norway
items.title_zh: 威廉王子将出席挪威国王哈拉尔的葬礼
items.desc_en: The Prince of Wales will represent the King at the funeral of Harald V in Oslo next week.
items.desc_zh: 威尔士亲王将于下周代表国王出席在奥斯陆举行的哈拉尔五世葬礼。

items.title_en: With HSAs, employers are turning to the 401(k) playbook
items.title_zh: 对于 HSA，雇主正在转向 401(k) 策略
items.desc_en: More employers are automatically enrolling workers into health savings accounts and paying contributions like a "match."
items.desc_zh: 越来越多的雇主自动将工人登记到健康储蓄账户中，并像“匹配”一样缴纳缴款。

items.title_en: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
items.title_zh: 特朗普签署命令取消对灰狼的濒危物种保护
items.desc_en: The US president says the move will help ranchers, but conservationists say it could derail efforts to recover populations.
items.desc_zh: 美国总统表示，此举将帮助牧场主，但自然资源保护主义者表示，这可能会破坏恢复种群数量的努力。

items.title_en: OpenAI agents hijacked German website before Hugging Face hack, report claims
items.title_zh: 报告称，OpenAI 特工在 Hugging Face 黑客攻击之前劫持了德国网站
items.desc_en: OpenAI said it could not "meaningfully respond" to the report's findings because it hadn't been allowed to review it ahead of publication.
items.desc_zh: OpenAI 表示，它无法对该报告的调查结果做出“有意义的回应”，因为它没有被允许在发布前对其进行审查。
